Two ways we work

Buying and selling, or building together.

Land sales

Know exactly what you are buying.

  • 30-year deed search and ownership verification
  • Encumbrance, mutation and classification checks
  • Circle-rate and fair-market valuation guidance
  • Boundary demarcation and possession status review
Joint ventures

Structure the partnership before the project starts.

  • Landowners matched with developers with proven track records
  • Agreements covering sharing ratio, deposits and timelines
  • Commercial, residential, IT and logistics project formats
  • Milestone monitoring from sanction to completion

From first call to registered handover.

Verify

Good to know

Land & JV questions

How does a joint venture work? +

A landowner contributes the land and a developer funds and executes the project. Terms such as area or revenue sharing, timelines and security are documented in a JV agreement before work begins.

What checks are done before a land deal? +

Deed chain and title verification, encumbrance checks, zoning and classification review, mutation records and boundary demarcation.

Do you only handle large land parcels? +

No. Our current portfolio ranges from around 25 Kathas to 10+ acres across commercial, industrial, logistics and residential use cases.

Can I list my own land with GB GROUP? +

Yes. Use the enquiry form on this page and include the location, approximate size and your preferred deal structure.
